hook: Hy‑Nomas builds explorable video worlds from text and camera controls.
hooks: Hy‑Nomas builds explorable video worlds from text and camera controls.
It runs on a single RTX 4090 and supports LoRA fine‑tuning.
Tencent says Hy‑Nomas runs on a single RTX 4090.
what_happened: Hy‑Nomas generates interactive video worlds from text and camera input, runs on one RTX 4090 with low-memory inference, and supports LoRA fine-tuning.
try_it: Runs on one RTX 4090 with INT8 weights and CPU offload (needs Linux, plenty of system RAM); try the online demo at hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/demo.
why_it_matters: It lets creators build interactive worlds on a single GPU and adapt the model for their own projects.
the_catch: The authors say it still trails Genie 3 on long-term spatial consistency, and cinematic LoRA tuning moderately regressed camera control.
caption: Hy‑Nomas is a free‑form interactive world‑generation model that runs on a single RTX 4090 and supports LoRA fine‑tuning. Would you run it on a single RTX 4090?
alt_text: The carousel explains that Hy‑Nomas lets users create interactive video worlds with text and camera, runs on one RTX 4090, and supports LoRA fine‑tuning.

es.hook: Hy‑Nomas crea mundos de video explorables a partir de texto y controles de cámara
es.what_happened: Hy‑Nomas genera mundos de video interactivos a partir de texto y entrada de cámara, funciona en una RTX 4090 con inferencia de bajo consumo de memoria y admite el ajuste fino LoRA
es.try_it: Funciona en una RTX 4090 con pesos INT8 y descarga a la CPU (requiere Linux y abundante RAM del sistema); prueba la demo en línea en hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/demo
es.why_it_matters: Permite a los creadores construir mundos interactivos con una sola GPU y adaptar el modelo a sus propios proyectos
es.the_catch: Los autores indican que aún queda detrás de Genie 3 en consistencia espacial a largo plazo, y que el ajuste LoRA cinematográfico redujo moderadamente el control de cámara
